confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are moderately confident; accommodation varies widely by district, season and event demand. Cocktail and wine are less certain and were cross-checked against the beer price (about 2.7 to 2.8 times beer). Local examples assume about 16,500 IDR per USD. The FX value came from search-result summaries that point to the RBA exchange-rates table; the RBA page itself was not opened, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast Asian capital-city price levels, adjusted for Indonesia's lower food costs and high taxes on alcohol, which keep beer, cocktails and wine relatively expensive.
